---
name: Bug report
about: A file's guidance is wrong, outdated, or conflicts with another file
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Which file

Path (e.g. `skills/dotnet/efcore/efcore.md`), and the section within it.

## What's wrong

- [ ] Incorrect / no longer accurate
- [ ] Outdated (references something that's changed, e.g. a .NET version, a deprecated API)
- [ ] Conflicts with another file — name the other file and the conflict
- [ ] Vendor-specific language leaked into core content (`skills/`, `rules/`, `agents/`, `workflows/`, `prompts/`)
- [ ] Broken reference (a `requires`/`related`/`optional`/link points to something that doesn't exist)
- [ ] Missing `index/*.yaml` entry
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Description

What's wrong, and — if you know it — what the correct content should say.

## Suggested fix

If you already know the fix, describe or link it here. Otherwise leave
blank; a maintainer or an AI assistant using this toolkit can triage it.
